summary: Distinct CC BY 4.0 single-leaf front door passes Subphase 5.0. Ten-light glazed wood entry leaf and fixed glazed sidelight; complete frame and pull handles. Robot/expert qualification remains pending.

component_review.frame: Fixed collidable source components [0, 1, 2]; modeled jamb/header partitioned where specified.
component_review.unlatched: No separate projecting latch/lock bolt identified; no collision excluded.

modifications: Select original Front_Door_001 and its matching frame from the CC BY USDZ; omit the 003 double-door and other displays, retain the packaged atlas.
Apply a proper Y-up to Z-up rotation and 1.000 uniform overall scale, with the modeled frame floor and selected opening as canonical origin; no reflection.
Infer the left-hand revolute axis opposite the source handle at measured leaf opening-face x=0.039802 m; no physical hinge dimensions are claimed.
Apply 2% uniform Panel/Handle clearance fitting about this selected leaf center. Keep all modeled leaf, glass, frame and handle collisions.
Partition the intact fixed frame component 2 at y=-0.4158/0.4078 m, 2 mm inside its measured opening-side jamb faces, plus the measured header. Keep frame and fixed sidelight collisions.
Begin closed and already unlatched; no separate projecting latch/lock bolt is identified.
limits: Ideal pivot inferred at source opening face, not measured hinge hardware.
Uniform moving-assembly clearance fit is a documented simulation approximation.
Isolated stop is geometry evidence; no robot/expert qualification was run.
